WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id_10,
    ABS(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value)) AS order_total_value
  FROM orders AS o
  INNER JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY
    LEFT(o.order_id, 10)
),
order_installment_flag AS (
  SELECT
    LEFT(op.order_id, 10) AS order_id_10,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(COALESCE(op.payment_installments, 0)) > 1 THEN 'installments'
      ELSE 'single_payment'
    END AS payment_installments_flag
  FROM order_payments AS op
  GROUP BY
    LEFT(op.order_id, 10)
)
SELECT
  oif.payment_installments_flag,
  AVG(ot.order_total_value) AS average_order_value
FROM order_totals AS ot
INNER JOIN order_installment_flag AS oif
  ON ot.order_id_10 = oif.order_id_10
GROUP BY
  oif.payment_installments_flag;
